messages.text:
So I think my PSU died on the s1. I tried different power outlets and no
signs of life from the PSU or S1 miner. When I plug in USB C cable it
starts up but obviously not enough power for it do anything.

Suggestions?

Thanks

Hi Jerimiah,

Glad you got to the bottom of it, and good news that it was just the fuse rather than the power supply. That one catches people out, because a dead fuse looks exactly like a dead PSU: nothing on the unit at all, while USB-C still wakes the board on its own.

For the record, both parts of Shop···· are shipped and closed out on our side, so nothing is still owed to you there.

If it ever does go quiet again, check the fuse first, then the DC barrel connection at the miner before assuming the supply. And if you want a faster answer on anything hands-on, JD and a lot of other owners are in our Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, he's @nullhashrate there. Otherwise just reply here and I'll pick it up.

Happy mining,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy
